minutes.headline: Personnel Committee voted to ask the Select Board to drop the longevity language from its article until fall.
minutes.summary: The committee discussed how to define which positions count as "director" for longevity pay in the Salary Administration Plan article. A proposal to key longevity to pay grade was liked but set aside because the grade structure may be consolidated. The committee voted to remove the longevity section, keep the position language, and have the chair ask the Select Board to make the change. A member also raised whether the personnel bylaw calls for an employee representative.

The chair will ask the Select Board to amend the article to drop the longevity piece; longevity returns in the fall with the SAP classification and comp plan work.
The committee debated what counts as a "director" position for longevity: directors would get the police or fire contract amount, all others the clerical amount.
